I’m trying to be practical, but I do care about comfort and tech. I’m looking for a 2019–2025 Audi A4 as my next hatchback within 40 miles of Spring Valley, NV, and I want it under $30,000 with under 90,000 miles; owners not a major concern. It should be gas with a cvt transmission and 4wd drivetrain, and it needs to fit seating for 6, 3 kids, 2 pets. Primary use cases are family, luxury, so cargo is moderate and my maintenance priority is luxury ok. Must-haves: adaptive cruise control, tow package, front parking sensors, blind spot monitoring, heated seats. Nice-to-haves: wireless charging, panoramic roof, third row seating, lane departure warning. Please avoid: roof rack. I prefer blue exterior, and I’m explicitly not shopping for truck, crossover, coupe body styles.

It should be gas with a manual transmission and 4wd drivetrain, and it needs to fit seating for 2, 1 kid, 2 pets. Primary use cases are commute, off_road, luxury, so I need fold-flat rear seats and my maintenance priority is luxury ok. Must-haves: lane keep assist, apple carplay, wireless charging, memory seats, panoramic roof. Nice-to-haves: leather seats, adaptive cruise control, tow package. Please avoid: third row seating, heated seats, roof rack. I prefer red or silver exterior, and I’m explicitly not shopping for minivan body styles.

Nice-to-haves: tow package, apple carplay, ventilated seats, panoramic roof. Please avoid: built in navigation. I prefer brown exterior, and I’m explicitly not shopping for truck, sedan, wagon body styles.

I’m looking for a 2013+ Mazda CX-30 in the truck category, located within 50 miles of Fort Lauderdale, FL. Budget is under $30,000, with moderate mileage. It should be hybrid-powered, have a manual transmission and 4WD drivetrain. Primary use will be commuting, family use, and ownership costs should stay luxury-acceptable. Must-have features include premium audio, third-row seating, backup camera; nice to have Apple CarPlay. Preferred exterior colors are silver.

I’m looking for a 2021+ Lexus RX in the coupe category, located within 50 miles of Charlotte, NC. Budget is under $42,000, with under 100,000 miles. It should be gas-powered, have a automatic transmission and 4WD drivetrain. Primary use will be outdoor trips, cargo hauling, commuting, and ownership costs should stay low-cost. Must-have features include third-row seating, backup camera; nice to have premium audio, and I want to avoid Android Auto, roof rack. Preferred exterior colors are gray.
I’m interested in a hybrid because fuel costs add up for me, and if I can find one under $30k with decent mileage, that would be ideal.
